answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational voyage to secure agent networks by requiring cryptographic proofs of unique human traits. Similar to the way water carves a karst landscape to isolate distinct channels, this mechanism filters identities, forcing attackers to acquire biological verification for each node. The cost to a malicious actor is thus elevated to the price of a walnut per unique human credential, rendering mass fabrication economically prohibitive within the decentralized consensus environment.
